Check that this machine can run sandboxes, and how to set it up


## Usage

```sh
codeflower check [flags]
```

## Flags

| Flag | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--engine string` | `auto` | engine to check: auto, docker, podman, or apptainer |
| `--image string` |  | sandbox image to look for |
| `--image-tag string` |  | build of the published image to use instead of 0.14.1, the release this app is made for: latest, another release (0.2.1, or 0.2 for its newest patch) or a commit (sha-abc1234) (or set $CODEFLOWER_IMAGE_TAG) |
